verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs claim support for 400+ TLDs (docs-9) but provide no per-TLD documentation of special requirements like restricted TLDs or country-code rules cited in the pack. Community hands-on reports concretely contradict full breadth claims, noting missing .us support and no IDN domain support even after the product's initial launch period (comm-11, comm-15), undercutting the 'TLDs I actually want' promise for many power users. missing for 10: per-TLD restriction/requirement documentation, evidence of ccTLD-specific rules, resolution of the .us/IDN gaps.
